modules.title: Module 1: Foundations of Career-Driven Problem Solving
modules.description: Establish a strong foundation by aligning problem-solving with career goals and learning style. Focus on motivation and basic problem-solving frameworks.

sub_modules.title: Sub-Module 1.1: Understanding Problem-Solving in Career Contexts
sub_modules.description: Explore how problem-solving directly impacts career growth and decision-making. Connect theoretical concepts to real-world scenarios.

activities.title: Activity 1.1.1: Self-Assessment Quiz on Problem-Solving
activities.description: Evaluate current problem-solving skills and identify gaps. Use results to tailor learning paths.

activities.title: Activity 1.1.2: Career-Driven Problem-Solving Case Study
activities.description: Analyze a case study of a professional facing a complex problem. Identify key steps in their solution process.

learning_outcomes: Understand the relationship between problem-solving and career success
Identify personal problem-solving strengths and weaknesses

sub_modules.title: Sub-Module 1.2: Building Motivation Frameworks
sub_modules.description: Develop strategies to sustain motivation through goal-setting, accountability, and progress tracking.

activities.title: Activity 1.2.1: SMART Goal Setting Workshop
activities.description: Create SMART goals for problem-solving projects. Focus on short-term wins to build momentum.

activities.title: Activity 1.2.2: Motivation Journaling
activities.description: Track daily progress and reflect on motivational triggers. Use prompts to reinforce commitment.

learning_outcomes: Apply SMART goal frameworks to career-related challenges

modules.title: Module 2: Strengthening Logical Reasoning and Mathematical Foundations
modules.description: Target weak areas in logical reasoning and mathematical skills through structured practice and adaptive difficulty.

sub_modules.title: Sub-Module 2.1: Logical Reasoning Fundamentals
sub_modules.description: Master core logical reasoning techniques to analyze problems systematically.

activities.title: Activity 2.1.1: Deductive Reasoning Puzzles
activities.description: Solve logic puzzles to strengthen deductive reasoning skills. Start with simple patterns and progress to complex scenarios.

activities.title: Activity 2.1.2: Logical Fallacy Identification
activities.description: Analyze common fallacies in problem-solving scenarios. Practice identifying and avoiding flawed reasoning.

learning_outcomes: Apply deductive and inductive reasoning to problem-solving

sub_modules.title: Sub-Module 2.2: Mathematical Problem-Solving Skills
sub_modules.description: Develop mathematical proficiency to tackle data-driven and quantitative problems.

activities.title: Activity 2.2.1: Math for Problem-Solving Basics
activities.description: Practice arithmetic, algebra, and basic statistics relevant to career-specific problem-solving scenarios.

activities.title: Activity 2.2.2: Real-World Data Analysis
activities.description: Analyze datasets to identify trends and make data-informed decisions. Use tools like spreadsheets or basic coding.

learning_outcomes: Solve quantitative problems using mathematical principles
Interpret and analyze data for decision-making

modules.title: Module 3: Advanced Problem-Solving Strategies
modules.description: Apply integrated skills to complex, career-specific challenges through collaborative and iterative problem-solving.

sub_modules.title: Sub-Module 3.1: Real-World Problem-Solving Scenarios
sub_modules.description: Simulate professional environments to practice solving multifaceted problems under time constraints.

activities.title: Activity 3.1.1: Career-Specific Case Study Challenge
activities.description: Work through a case study mimicking a real-world problem in your field. Use logical reasoning, math, and motivation strategies.

activities.title: Activity 3.1.2: Peer Review and Feedback
activities.description: Present solutions to peers for constructive feedback. Refine approaches based on collaborative insights.

learning_outcomes: Solve complex, career-specific problems using integrated skills
Refine solutions through feedback and iteration

sub_modules.title: Sub-Module 3.2: Iterative Problem-Solving Frameworks
sub_modules.description: Master frameworks like Design Thinking or Agile to approach problems in stages and adapt to changing requirements.

activities.title: Activity 3.2.1: Design Thinking Workshop
activities.description: Follow the Design Thinking process (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test) to solve a simulated career problem.

activities.title: Activity 3.2.2: Agile Problem-Solving Simulation
activities.description: Use Agile methodologies to break down a large problem into smaller, manageable tasks with iterative improvements.

learning_outcomes: Apply iterative frameworks to complex problem-solving

modules.title: Module 4: Sustaining Motivation and Accountability
modules.description: Reinforce motivation and accountability through structured habits, reflection, and long-term planning.

sub_modules.title: Sub-Module 4.1: Motivation Maintenance Strategies
sub_modules.description: Develop sustainable habits to stay motivated during long-term problem-solving projects.

activities.title: Activity 4.1.1: Habit Stacking for Motivation
activities.description: Integrate problem-solving tasks into existing daily routines to build consistency.

activities.title: Activity 4.1.2: Weekly Motivation Check-In
activities.description: Reflect on progress, celebrate small wins, and adjust strategies as needed.

sub_modules.title: Sub-Module 4.2: Accountability Systems
sub_modules.description: Create systems to track progress and stay accountable to personal and professional goals.

activities.title: Activity 4.2.1: Accountability Partner Setup
activities.description: Find a peer or mentor to review progress and provide encouragement.

activities.title: Activity 4.2.2: Progress Dashboard Creation
activities.description: Build a visual tracker for problem-solving milestones using tools like Trello or Notion.

learning_outcomes: Establish accountability mechanisms for long-term goals

quiz_adaptations: Adjust difficulty of logical/math activities based on quiz performance (e.g., repeat sub-modules if scores < 60%)
Increase motivation-focused activities if self-reported motivation drops below 50%
